spans.s:
ind.
As, like, similar: this is more generally considered as an affix to words, termed technically वति, as ब्राह्मणवत् like a Brahman, &c.

mfn. (वान् वाती वान्ती वात्)
Going, moving.
E.
वा to go, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Uttered, sounded, spoken.
2 Asked, begged.
ind.
1 A particle analogous to ah, oh, &c. expressing sorrow.
2

Compassion.
3

Pleasure.
4

Oh, ho, a vocative particle.
E.
वन to ask or beg, &c., aff. क्त.

r. 1st cl. (वातयति)
1 To go.
2 To serve.
3 To be happy.
4 To give pleasure in travelling.
5 To blow gently, to fan or ventilate.

m. (-तः)
1 Air, wind.
2 Rheumatism, gout, inflammation of the joints.
2 Air, wind, as one of the humours of the body.
E.
वा to go, Uṇādi aff. तन्.

m. (-सः)
1 An ear-ring.
2 A crest.
E.
अव before तसि to adorn, and अच् aff., the initial rejected; also अवतंस.

m. (-ण्डः)
The name of a Muni.
E.
अव before वडि to beat, aff. अच्, and अ rejected.

f. (-का)
A cow miscarrying from accident.
E.
अव before तोक offspring, and अ rejected; also अवतोका.

n. (-त्सं)
The breast, the chest.
m. (-त्सः)
1 A calf.
2 A year.
mf. (-त्सः-त्सा)
A term of endearment, used to children, scholars, &c.
E.
वद to speak, kindly to, Uṇādi aff. स.

m. (-कः)
1 A calf.
2 A child.
3 A medicinal plant, (Wrightea antidysenterica.)
E.
वत्स, and कन् added.

n. (-कं)
A herd of calves.
E.
वत्स a calf, वुञ् aff. of number.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Fond of or anxious about a child.
f. (-मा)
A cow anxious after her calf, a mother anxious after her child, &c.
E.
वत्स a calf, and काम to desire, aff. अङ् and टाप्.

m. (-रुः)
A master.
E.
वत्स, and गुरु teacher.

m. (-रः)
A steer.
E.
वत्स a calf, and तरप् aff. of excess; more than a calf.

f. (-न्त्री)
The rope that ties a calf.
E.
वत्स, and तन्त्री a string.

m. (-भः)
An active poison; also called Mīthā Zeher, the root of the Aconite ferox brought from Nepal.
E.
वत्स a calf, and नभ to injure, अण् aff.; the root is sometimes compared to the nipple of a cow, whence perhaps this etymology.

n. (-नं)
The name of a city in the north of India; one place to which it is applied is now a village in the district of Gorakhpur.
E.
वत्स a calf, and पत्तन a city.

m. (-रः)
A year.
E.
वद to abide, and सरन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
Name of a month, Phalguna.
E.
वत्सर, and अन्तक destroyer.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Affectionate, kind.
n. (-लं)
Affection, fondness.
f. (-ला)
A cow anxious for her calf.
E.
वत्स a child, and लच् aff.

f. (-ता)
Tenderness, affection.
E.
वत्सल, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, वत्सलत्वं.

f. (-क्षी)
A kind of cucumber, (Cucumis madraspatanus.)

f. (-नी)
A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.)
E.
वत्स a calf, &c., अदन food.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Proper or fit for a calf.
m. (-यः)
A cowherd.
E.
वत्स a calf, &c., and छ aff.

m. (-कः)
A plant, (Marsilea quadrifolia.)
E.
वात wind, कृ to make, aff. ड.

mfn. (-की-किनी-कि)
Rheumatic, gouty.
E.
वात inflammation of the joints, and इनि aff., कूक् augment.

f. (-का)
Scanty and painful flow of urine.

m. (-म्भः)
The part of an elephant's forehead below the frontal sinuses.
E.
वात wind, and कुम्भ a receptacle.

m. (-तुः)
Dust.
E.
वात wind, and केतु a symbol.

m. (-लिः)
1 Speaking in murmurs, especially amorous converse.
2 The marks of finger nails on the lover's person.
E.
वात wind, केलि playing.

m. (-मी)
A bird.
E.
वात wind, and गामिन् who goes.

m. (-ल्मः)
1 A gale, a high wind.
2 Acute gout or rheumatism.
E.
वात wind, गुल्म a cluster, a quantity.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
1

Epileptic.
2

Rheumatic.
E.
वात, and ग्रस्त seized.

mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं)
Removing disorders from wind.
E.
वात, and घ्न who destroys.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Produced by or arising from wind.
E.
वात, and ज born.

m. (-रः)
Fever arising from vitiated wind.
E.
वात, and ज्वर fever.

n. (-लं)
Cottony flocks or seeds floating in the air.
E.
वात wind, तूल cotton.

f. (-डा)
1 A gale, a high wind.
2 Acute gout or rheumatism.
3 A handsome woman.
4 A disease, a sort of small pox.
E.
वात wind, हुड to reap, aff. क, deriv. irr.

m. (-जः)
A cloud.
E.
वात wind, and ध्वज banner.

n. (-त्तं)
Rheumatism attended with fever.
E.
वात, and पित्त bile.

m. (-त्त्रः)
1 A name of BHĪ

MA.
2
The monkey

HANUMĀN.
3

A cheat, a swindler.
E.
वात the wind, and पुत्त्र a son.

m. (-थः)
The Palāśa tree, (Butea frondosa.)
E.
वात rheumatism, पुथ to hurt, aff. अण्; also वातपोथक.

m. (-मीः)
A swift antelope.
E.
वात the wind, प्र before मा to measure, to surpass or outgo, Uṇādi aff. ईप्.

mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं)
Inflated, puffed up with wind.
E.
वात, and फुल्ल blown.

n. (-न्त्रं)
Cholic, flatulence, borborygmi.
E.
वात wind, फुल्ल swoln, अन्त्र the intestines.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Going in or against the wind.
m. (-जः)
An antelope.
E.
वात wind, अज to go, aff. खश्.

f. (-ली)
A whirlwind.
E.
वात wind, मण्डल a region, aff. ङीप्.

m. (-गः)
A swift antelope.
E.
वात wind, and मृग a deer.

mfn. (-हाः-हाः-हः)
Swift, (as the wind.)
E.
वात, and रंहस् speed.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Windy, stormy.
2 Swift, (as the wind.)
E.
वात, रा to get, क aff.

n. (-क्तं)
Acute gout or rheumatism.
E.
वात wind, and रक्त blood; ascribed to a vitiated state of the blood and the aerial humour.

m. (-घ्नः)
A plant, commonly Kukurmurā.
E.
वातरक्त gout, and घ्न destroying.

m. (-रिः)
A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.)
E.
वातरक्त acute gout, and अरि a foe.

m. (-थः)
A cloud.
E.
वात the wind, and रथ a car.

m. (-णः)
1 An arrow.
2 An arrow's flight, the discharge of an arrow, a bow shot.
3 A saw.
4 The peak of a mountain.
5 A mad man, one wild or intoxicated, either literally or figuratively.
6 An idler, one who lives to no purpose.
7 The Saral, a sort of pine tree.
E.
वातर, and अयन going.

m. (-षः)
1 A gale, a breeze.
2 The rainbow.
3 A bribe.
E.
वात wind, रूष to rage, aff. क.

n. (-गं)
Rheumatism, gout.
E.
वात wind, and रोग disease.

mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि)
Rheumatic, afflicted with gout or rheumatism, especially of the acute kind.
E.
वातरोग acute rheumatism, &c., aff. इनि.

m. (-र्द्धिः)
1 A sort of cup or vessel made of wood, with an iron foot or stand.
2 A mace, a club or stick bound with iron.
E.
वात wind, ऋद्धि increase.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Windy, stormy.
2 Flatulent.
m. (-लः)
1 A sort of pulse, (Cicer arietinum.)
2 Wind.
f. (-ला)
A morbid state of the uterus.
E.
वात wind, ला to get, aff. क.

f. (-ली)
A whirlwind.
E.
वातल windy, मण्डल a region, aff. ङीप्; also वातमण्डली.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Windy, gusty.
E.
वात, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-कः)
Nervous or low fever.

f. (-स्तिः)
Suppression of urine.
E.
वात, and वस्ति the bladder.

f. (-द्धिः)
Swelled testicle.
E.
वात, and वृद्धि increase.

f. (-धिः)
Any morbid affection attributed to disorder of the wind.
E.
वात, and व्याधि disease.

m. (-री)
The castor oil tree, &c.; see वातारि.

n. (-र्षं)
The lower belly.
E.
वात wind, शीर्ष the head or source.

n. (-लं)
Cholic with flatulence.
E.
वात, and शूल cholic.

n. (-तं)
Acute gout or rheumatism.
E.
वात wind, शोणित blood; ascribed to a vitiated state of these two.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Gouty, rheumatic.
E.
वात the disease, and सह bearing, suffering.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Rheumatic, gouty.
E.
बात rheumatism, and आसह who bears or suffers.

m. (-थिः)
AGNI or fire.
E.
वात wind, and सारथि charioteer.

n. (-न्धं)
The portion of the atmosphere where the wind blows.
E.
वात wind, स्कन्ध part.

m. (-टः)
1 A horse of the sun.
2 An antelope.
E.
वात the wind, and अट who goes.

n. (-नं)
Forcing the wind downwards, as in inflating the lungs.

m. (-पिः)
The name of an Asura devoured by AGASTYA.
E.
वात wind, पा to drink, aff. कि, and आङ् prefixed.

m. (-द्विट्)
The Muni AGASTYA.
E.
वातापि, and द्विष who hates; also similar names, as वातापिसूदन, बातापिहन्, &c.

f. (-दा)
Musk.
E.
वात the wind, आमोदा a diffusive fragrance.

n. (-यं)
A leaf.
E.
वात wind, अय to go, aff. अच्.

n. (-नं)
1 A window, an eyelet or loop-hole.
2 A porch, a portico, a covered shed, a pavilion.
m. (-नः)
A horse.
E.
वात the wind, and अयन going.

m. (-युः)
An antelope, a deer.
E.
वात wind, (like,) अय to go, aff. उण्.

f. (-रिः)
1 The castor oil tree.
2 A plant, (Asparagus racemosus.)
E.
वात rheumatism, अरि hostile.

f. (-ली)
A whirlwind, a gale.
E.
वात wind, आली a line.

m. (-श्वः)
A swift horse, or one of a good breed.
E.
वात the wind, and अश्व a horse.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Stirred or shaken by the wind.
2 Affected by rheumatism.
E.
वात, and आहत struck.

f. (-तिः)
1 The action of the wind.
2 The occurrence of arthritic pains.
E.
वात, and आहति striking.

m. (-तिः)
Air, wind.
E.
वा to go, Uṇādi aff. अति.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Windy, stormy.
2

Rheumatic.
3

Produced by or proceeding from wind, (disease, &c.)
n. (-कं)
Fever or inflammation ascribed to a vitiated state of the aerial humour.
E.
वात wind, &c., ठक् aff.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Acquainted with or working in minerals or fossils, &c.
m. (-गः)
The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.)
E.
वाति wind, and ग who counts, from गण with ड aff.

m. (-णः)
The egg-plant.
E.
वाति wind, गण to count, aff. खच्, curing rheumatism, &c.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Windy, relating or belonging to wind, &c.
n. (-यं)
Sour rice-gruel.
E.
वात the wind, छ aff.; acidulated by air.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Gouty, rheumatic.
2 Mad, crazy.
m. (-लः)
A whirlwind, a gale.
E.
वात wind, &c., and उलच् aff.; more commonly वातूल.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Gouty, rheumatic.
2 Mad, insane, inebriate.
m. (-लः)
A whirlwind, a gale, a hurricane.
E.
वात wind, ऊलच् aff.; also वातुल; form irr.

f. (-लिः)
A large bat, commonly the flying-fox.
E.
वात wind, उलि aff., form irr.

m. (-ता)
Air, wind.
E.
वा to go, तृच् aff.

f. (-त्या)
Strong wind, a gale, a whirlwind, a hurricane.
E.
वात wind, यत् implying quantity.

n. (-ल्यं)
Tenderness, affection, fondness.
E.
वत्सल affectionate, यञ् aff.

m. (-त्त्रः)
A barber.
E.
वात्सी a girl born of a Śūdra woman by a Brahman, and पुत्त्र son.

m. (-नः)
The name of a Muni.
E.
वात्स्य the father of the sage, and फक् aff. of descent.
